# AGENTS.md — exo

Guidance for AI coding agents working in this repo.

## Project Overview

exo is a distributed AI inference system that connects multiple devices into a cluster. It runs large language models across multiple machines using MLX as the inference backend and zenoh for peer-to-peer networking.

## Build & Run

```bash
# Build the dashboard (required before running exo)
cd dashboard && npm install && npm run build && cd ..

# Run exo (starts master + worker, API at http://localhost:52415)
uv run exo

# Verbose logging
uv run exo -v   # or -vv

# Tests (slow tests excluded by default)
uv run pytest
uv run pytest -m ""                       # include slow tests
uv run pytest src/exo/shared/tests/test_election.py
uv run pytest src/exo/shared/tests/test_election.py::test_function_name

# Type checking (strict)
uv run basedpyright

# Linting
uv run ruff check

# Format
nix fmt
```
